newsitem.title: USA: Texan kills noisy son during football game.
newsitem.headline: Texan kills noisy son during football game.

text.p: A Texan beat his 3-year-old son to death for making too much noise during Sunday's televised Dallas Cowboys football game, police said on Tuesday.
James Thornton III was punched several times in the stomach and suffered a ruptured liver and kidney. He died under surgery in a Dallas hospital on Monday.
A police spokesman said James Thornton II was charged with injury to a child but that the charge might be upgraded to capital murder, which carries a possible death sentence.

Thornton, 25, allegedly lost his temper when his son began jumping up and down and making noise during the third quarter of the Cowboys game against New England on Sunday afternoon. Police said he punched the boy three or four times and then put him to bed.
The boy's mother, who does not live with Thornton, found her son unconscious in bed when she went to pick him up after letting him spend the weekend with his father.

Results of an autopsy on the boy were expected later on Tuesday and police said they would decide then whether to upgrade the charges against Thornton. He was being held in jail in lieu of $25,000 bail.
